test_title: PYST 28: SSC CHSL 2023 - English (Held On: 10 Aug, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: english
question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 2.**
solution: The correct answer is: **Governed** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **Governed **means to be controlled or directed by a particular set of rules or laws. (नियमों या कानूनों के किसी विशेष समूह द्वारा नियंत्रित या निर्देशित किया जाना) • The word fits the sentence contextually and grammatically. • **Example**: *The country is governed by a democratically elected government.* Thus,** option 1** is the correct answer. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • **Rehearsed **means to practice something, like a performance or speech. (किसी चीज़ का अभ्यास करना, जैसे प्रदर्शन या भाषण) • **Dominated **means to have power or control over something or someone. (किसी चीज़ या व्यक्ति पर शक्ति या नियंत्रण रखना) • **Unorganised **means lacking structure or order. (संरचना या व्यवस्था का अभाव) 44:Ta1f, The correct answer is: **Encompassing**.
